best_idea: Keep one hate table per NPC that accumulates damage per attacker, pick the strict maximum with a stable tie-break, and on every pick validate the top and drop it if it is dead, off-map or gone, before taking the next one.
decision_why: The accumulate, max-pick and validate-drop loop is the right shape for many-on-one aggro under MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; take the shape, add a deterministic tie-break and a cap at the point of entry, purge stale entries on leave, and do not take the per-NPC thread or the sight-order target.
acceptance: Server test: attacker A hits for 30 first on an NPC with maxHp 200 (hate 50), attacker B hits for 40 (hate 40), so A is the target; when A is dead the next pick is B with no exception; a seed of hate 0 does not consume the first-hit bonus; equal hate picks the lower id on every run.
